notes.title: Dev Update: Thank you for 140,000 wishlists!
notes.notes:
Hiiii from Springloaded,
[p align="justify"]Hope you're having a great August! We've been busy working away on Let's Build a Dungeon and have quite a few updates to share with you, including an upcoming livestream and beta key giveaway. Keep reading for:
[olist]
Developer Livestream & Giveaway

Game Mode Breakdown: 4 Ways to Play

Exclusive Art Drop

BitSummit, PGDX & Tacticon
[/olist]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2365790/Lets_Build_a_Dungeon/"][/dynamiclink]
1. Developer Livestream & Giveaway
Let's Build a Dungeon now has more than 140,000 wishlists!!!

This is such a crazy amount for us to comprehend and we're really grateful for the support. 
[p align="justify"]We try not to look at the wishlist numbers too much, because our focus is on making the best game that we can regardless of the total. But... it feels really nice to know that we have 140,000 of you along for the ride, excited to create alongside us when the game releases. So thank you for making that happen <3



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/90d867e49b36d3b99856bc1d8edae8bea6a50615.gif"]

To celebrate and say thank you properly, we're hosting a Developer Livestream on August 28th over on our Twitch channel. (You can use that link to receive a reminder on the day.)

Join us at 9am EDT / 1pm UTC / 9pm SGT for: 

Beta key giveaway

Let's Build a Zoo key giveaway

A behind the scenes look at the current build

Q&A with Game Director James Barnard



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/92c21ee772cd69e46ebcdc6bc30916a64bcd6da9.png



Please submit your questions for the Q&A using this form or the button above. Feel free to ask us anything about Let's Build a Dungeon, Springloaded, our summer plans or games we've been playing - (almost) anything goes and we can't wait to see you in Twitch chat.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/baae2921c28ccc8afe9c91e6bd5e7d966eb43213.gif"]
2. Game Mode Breakdown: 4 Ways to Play
Want to know more about the different ways you can play Let's Build a Dungeon? We've made a handy video explaining everything you need to know, which you can check out below:
[previewyoutube="w9x1hGEJ-hw;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="justify"]There are 4 distinct game modes and each one offers a unique gameplay experience. Here's a very quick overview:

Campaign Mode - In-depth game dev sim with studio management and game making

Just Build Mode - Streamlined game dev sim focused on world building, solo or with friends

Creative Mode - Open sandbox ft. all game-making tools 

Dungeoneering - Community game library
3. Exclusive Art Drop
We're constantly drawing and painting new in-game assets and thought it's probably about time we shared some previews of what we've been up to. There are hundreds of new items being added to Let's Build a Dungeon weekly, including countless buildings, dungeons and interiors. We picked out a couple of our favourites to share, starting with... the Swap and Sell shop interior and an introduction to GameLink.
Swap and Sell Shop


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/0ecaef8de53e941c21f9086ac0e08a0a24de91d1.png"]

Inspired by the old Exchange and Mart stores that used to be in the UK, (anyone remember those?!) the Swap and Sell shop is a nostalgic junk store selling every kind of item you could think of. From instruments to arcade machines, computers to books - the shop is small but full to the brim of treasures. This interior was especially fun to design, as it contains a real mix of items and themes, which is pretty different to a lot of the other pre-set buildings in Let's Build a Dungeon. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/57db5906e30cf088fe54b28530f4719beb315433.jpg"]
GameLink Capsule Images
In Campaign Mode, you'll track the performance of any games your studio releases on GameLink: a virtual storefront that is definitely, 100% legally distinct from any other real world digital storefronts that sell video games.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/a34ed6230633771fba8e6190f0c8ac480848732e.gif"]



GameLink will show you how your own game is charting, alongside the performance of other games that have been released too. It also does a whole bunch of other stuff that we can't wait to share with you, but that's for another time.

So for the past few weeks, we've been coming up with a host of inspired fake game titles that you may come across whilst browsing GameLink. You can see a couple of the titles below, each with unique key art created by our artist Ryan. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/ae98d27abb6fdd4c4546c256beba142de3be04b2.png"]


4. BitSummit, PGDX & Tacticon
Last month we took our event demo back out on the road, setting up booths at both BitSummit in Kyoto and the Philippine Game Dev Expo in Manila. We always enjoy sharing the game in person and the feedback we've received so far has been invaluable. Thank you to anyone that stopped by to say hi! The Let's Build a Dungeon Steam demo is still live, so if you want a taster and missed our event showings, please check it out and consider leaving us a review - every one helps!
[p align="justify"]We were also invited to take part in our first ever Tacticon, which is a celebration of all things strategy games. James joined a panel to discuss the challenges of making games that are low stress but high strategy, so if that's your kind of thing you can watch it over on the official Tacticon YouTube channel.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/73f7f0f0665c6bf309caff9663b686e2ca603c10.png"]

And that's a wrap for now! We're continuing to make good progress and we're really seeing Let's Build a Dungeon coming to life piece by piece. If you'd like to see a behind the scenes look at the current build, make sure to join us on August 28th for the livestream, and don't forget to send in your questions for the Q&A. 

Thanks for continuing to support Let's Build a Dungeon. We'll see you again soon for more updates.

Team Springloaded

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/13ae7a03b37b3aeda238bc3678fabe9c297c4bfd.gif"]

notes.title: Dev Update: May 2025 - A New Game Mode?!
notes.notes:
Hello from Springloaded! 

It's developer diary time again and we're excited to be back sharing the latest Let's Build a Dungeon update from our team here in Singapore. We took a little break to focus on development, so there's a lot to update you on. 

1. What's New?

It's been a few weeks since our last update, and things have been really coming along behind the scenes. From finalising Creative Mode features (more on that in the next segment), to developing story arcs for the Campaign Mode - we're seeing more and more of the game coming to life.

We've also been finishing up something... totally new 👀

We're gearing up to announce a brand new game mode and wanted you to be the first to know that it's coming!

On top of the existing Campaign Mode and Creative Mode, we've got something cool in the works to provide a chilled, sandbox experience with a twist.

We can't share too many details and probably already said too much... but you won't have to wait long for the full reveal. The new mode will be revealed as part of the upcoming Wholesome Direct on Saturday June 7, at 9am PT / 12pm ET / 6pm CET. We hope you can tune in for a real team building experience, we can't wait to see what you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/8b59306e2d1086a2090a1a74795a2257527525c6.gif

2. Watch the Livestream and Q&A

If you're interested in learning more about Creative Mode but missed our first developer stream, don't worry! We just uploaded the full recording to our YouTube channel and you can check it out by clicking the link below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/4a8c6412f0900f10577748075e0adeafe2f6a852.png

Tune in for a 90+ minute deep dive into Let's Build a Dungeon and the Creative Tools we're in the process of fine-tuning. Prepare for lots of work in progress stuff, but it's super fun for us to share our process with you. Game Director James Barnard walks through the steps to create your own custom game, whilst answering some of your most asked questions. (Thank you to everyone that submitted questions, let's do it all again soon!)

3. Design Inspiration - Plumose Village Introduction

We've been really digging into the Campaign Mode of Let's Build a Dungeon recently, and thought it might be fun to share some of the world with you in a bit more detail. Starting by taking a look at one of the first locations you’ll come across: Plumose Village. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/8f828c4452aa55ab17888ad5426c27b60bfd680c.png

We've been powering through development of the Campaign Mode of Let's Build a Dungeon recently, and thought it might be fun to share more of the world with you in a bit more detail. Starting by taking a look at one of the first locations you’ll come across when it comes to building your MMORPG: Plumose Village. 

If you played the demo (available here) you might already be a little familiar with Plumose. Uniquely situated, this mill town capitalises on the abundance of wind thistle seeds that blow over the island from a far off land. Driven by unique atmospheric patterns, nowhere else sees as many wind thistle seeds as Plumose does.

These seeds are used for multiple things, but the most popular use is making ‘thistle-bread’, a light, pale purple loaf that is enjoyed across the kingdom. While not as widely available as normal wheat based bread, thistle bread is an enjoyable alternative due to its unique nutty taste and light airy composition. Despite its comparative rarity, thistle bread is not seen as a luxury, meaning that Wind Farmers are not especially wealthy, and live humble lives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/ff9b3f8a636c5b994a7c419e0a971d6752e7bd61.gif

The farmers of Plumose Village build large wind intakes to filter the air for seeds, which also provide the power needed to grind seeds into flour. Fan-like blades sit on top of the buildings, collecting seeds that drift through the air into the grindstone area at the base of the mill. Usually farmers live in these buildings, leading to super dense interiors with cramped sleeping quarters and tiny stoves.

Any attempts to grow the wind thistle have proved fruitless, and the appearance of the thistle plants remains a mystery.

As you progress through Let's Build a Dungeon, you'll learn more about the villagers who call Plumose home by designing multiple quests focused on their passion for Wind Farming!

4. You Built a Dungeon

Did you know we have an official Discord server for talking about all things Let's Build a Dungeon? Come and join us over there!

We have a channel called #show-us-your-rpg and use it to see what everyone has been building in the demo. We're gonna close out this latest update with some of our favourite recent community builds from Discord.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2365790/Lets_Build_a_Dungeon/

Thank you for continuing to support Let's Build a Dungeon. The demo is still available to download, so please make sure to check it out if you didn't already, and leave us a review so we know what you think!

We'll see you again soon for more updates.

Team Springloaded

notes.title: 2025: Year of the Dungeon - Dev Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!

2025 is well under way and we're excited to be back working on Let's Build a Dungeon after a short break for the holidays. We're heading into the new year feeling great about what's to come and with some big plans on the horizon.

Our demo is available to download now, so make sure to check it out if you want to experience a taste of what's to come. It's been a lot of fun seeing everyone designing their own RPG worlds, so please keep sharing your creations!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3340480/Lets_Build_a_Dungeon_Demo/

Since the demo launched we've had thousands of responses to our feedback form, so thank you to everyone that took part so far. (It's linked in the demo but also available here.) Every submission helps us massively! 

We had a dig through the feedback data and found some fun stats:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/fda02b96456a8961db49d1948331768c145c12ed.png
 Played in 10 languages, the top 3 being English, German and French
 40% of responding players chose the Explorer hero class, whilst only 24% chose Mage
 60% hadn't played our previous game Let's Build a Zoo (exciting to have so many new people joining our community)
 94% of players that responded completed the demo to the end 
The demo now has over 200 positive reviews (!!) and it's been great to see such an encouraging response. We've had quite a few questions about design inspiration, so without giving too much away for anyone that hasn't played it yet... we want to share some insight.

Demo Design Insights

We're big MMORPG fans and Ultima is of course one of the most iconic titles in the genre, so finding a way to pay tribute was on our list to tackle at some point down the line. Our goal for Let's Build a Dungeon is to encompass everything that makes (and has made) the games industry what it is today - and that covers a whole crazy list of historic moments that shaped the games we play today. 

One of those moments is the 'assassination of Lord British' in Ultima Online. As an in-game rebellion that went on to influence so many instalments of the series, it marked a real shift in dynamics between creators and players. These kind of moments don't happen often, and when they do they deserve to be remembered! Justin Olivetti at Massively Overpowered wrote a great article about the importance of what happened in the early days of Ultima Online and how things went down, so one to check out here if you want more details.

As we worked to finalise the end of the demo, we realised that this was the perfect opportunity to have some fun with the player/developer relationship in Let's Build a Dungeon. We're really happy with how it turned out, and hope you enjoy it too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/1ef35b02863fec9200455f22bfe0918afa6ea55a.gif

What's Next?

We recently went to Taipei Game Show in Taiwan and had a great time showcasing the game there for the first time. We took part in IGN's livestream from the showfloor and got to meet so many amazing people. If you stopped by to say hi during the show, thank you! It's always fun to hang out in person.

Later in the year we'll be attending more events (it's a little early to confirm just now) and in the very near future, we'll be holding a livestream hosted by our Game Director James. We plan to play through some work-in-progress stuff that we probably shouldn't show yet... but it's fun to get feedback and hear what you think! Once we confirm the date and time, we'll post an update, or you can also stay in touch with us more frequently by joining our Discord server.

We also have a newsletter/beta mailing list that receives 1 email per month with a behind the scenes update, and is always the first place to hear about beta opportunities. Click the banner below to register.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/2f74bf1a115541e93b06f9a43cbc6db3bbe24192.gif

Lastly, an update on game progress. It would take way too long to list everything we've been up to over the past few weeks, but here's a list of some things we've been focusing on:


 Building an early version of creative mode for beta testers (hopefully coming soon)
 Writing story arcs for the simulation campaign
 Many, MANY new art assets 
 Online infrastructure and initial set-up
 Controller support testing and improvements (not available in the current demo)
 Removal of placeholder art 
 Trading card implementation (we're currently tagged as 'profile features limited' but this will be removed once set up is complete, hooray!)
 Workaround for playing the demo on Steam Deck (read our guide to playing on Steam Deck)

We've got a lot of exciting plans and will be back with livestream updates and more soon. Thanks as always for your support!

Springloaded

notes.title: Thanks for a great demo launch! Demo Patch v0.0.1-R Now Live
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The Let's Build a Dungeon demo has been available for just under a week and it's been such a joy (and a relief!!) to see so many of you playing and enjoying it. We have a lot more work to do, but seeing your worlds and dungeons come to life has been bringing us so much joy! (We'll share some of our favourite designs at the end of this post)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3340480/Lets_Build_a_Dungeon_Demo/

Thanks for continuing to share feedback with us in the community hub, Discord and via the in-game form. We just pushed a new demo update live so wanted to drop in to share the fixes and changes included. We'll be continuing to review feedback and update the demo gradually as we gather more insight, and will keep you up to date with our plans as much as possible. 

Demo Patch v0.0.1-R

New
- Added tie functionality for twitch poll, giving streamers the option to pick between tied options
- Added asset swap tutorial in asset backlog

Bug Fixes
- Fixed wall surface being deleted when painting floors
- WASD Camera Movement Improvements when in Playmode
- Fixed Twitch Poll bug in desktop mode
- Fixed engagement circle in omnidex minimap depending on whether the player holds the scanner
- Fixed collision against doors and NPCs in playmode
- Fixed AI pathing and actions behaviour
- General bug fixes

Crash Fixes
- Fixed a crash with shift deleting buildings
- Fixed a crash with Turkish keyboard inputs

We're continuing to make improvements and work through all the feedback - so thanks again for your support.

A few cool things to share with you before we go!

We debuted a new trailer at the PC Gaming Show (!!) and you can see it here: [previewyoutube=uk3VqrdJCb0;full][/previewyoutube]

Aaaand we won a Chat Choice Award at the 2024 OTK Winter Games Expo - which we were not expecting at all. The developer grant will help us to keep improving our Twitch integration, and we already have some cool things planned, so watch this space...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/a62843b0109cfcb6174dd629affefcfb09fc5689.png

If you're playing the demo, please consider leaving a review on the demo page and share your screenshots and world designs with us - either in the community hub thread or over on Discord in the #show-us-your-RPG channel. You can see just a few of our favourites below!

Thanks for being here and we'll be back with more updates soon.

Team Springloaded

notes.title: Dev Update: Thank you for 60,000 wishlists!
notes.notes:
Hello from Springloaded!

We’ve been completely overwhelmed by the response since announcing Let's Build a Dungeon, and it's amazing to see how many people are interested in our little game dev sim. We’re a small team with big plans and can’t wait to share them with you - so thank you for being here. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/13ae7a03b37b3aeda238bc3678fabe9c297c4bfd.gif

It's been a crazy 2 months and there's a lot to share with you - but first we need to say a huge thank you for helping us to pass 60,000 wishlists!?! We're grateful for your support and super excited to have you on board for the ride. If you haven't added us to your wishlist yet, you can use the button below to make sure you receive the latest updates from us as they happen.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2365790/Lets_Build_a_Dungeon/ 

We recently took our first ever event demo out on the road and had a blast watching everyone play. We did a remote demo at Gamescom in Cologne on the Xbox booth and then spent 4 crazy days on the PAX Rising booth at PAX West in Seattle. We came away with a bunch of new ideas and feedback which was great, and also some cool character designs (below left) created by 10 year old Miles. He stopped by our booth and convinced us to close the event demo build and let him play with the full development build and Creative Mode tools…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/07b2826378cad49ccc8115f0b0550476f0302d6e.png

Not long after our trip to Seattle, we were setting the booth up again at Tokyo Game Show. Let’s Build a Dungeon was selected as a finalist for the Sense of Wonder Night awards which was a big honour and  we weren’t sure if our name accidentally got added to the list by mistake... We didn’t win (spoilers) but you can watch our presentation over on YouTube and hear the might of the audience’s Piko Piko hammers for yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/c61e089f2ba1ea45b282f7206a4c244ae7f30a2a.png

And finally, we made it to our hometown show last week - Gamescom Asia in Singapore. It's always a joy to exhibit alongside other developers from Singapore, Southeast Asia and beyond and this year was no exception. Let's Build a Dungeon won the Indie Wavemakers Judges' Choice Award which was a wild moment for us and we're really honoured to have been selected. Thank you to everyone that came to play the demo, took time to say hello to us or wave a Piko Piko hammer for us at the SOWN awards. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147623/c7a570157e0c164de39219b8846228565fd4915a.jpg

Game wise, we opened our playtest to the first wave of participants and it's been great to have feedback coming in from outside the studio. There's still time to sign up for our beta/playtest sessions using the form on our website and we'll be gradually expanding the group over the coming weeks and months. We're currently working really hard to prepare a demo to share on Steam, and we're grateful for your patience! More on that coming soon...

Lastly, if you have any questions about Let's Build a Dungeon or our plans, please let us know and we'll do our best to answer them. You can also find us over on Discord where we're often sharing behind the scenes updates each week. 

Thanks again for being here, and we'll be back with more updates soon!

Springloaded
